cohort_total_n_excerpt: Telephone interviews were completed with 416 incident prostate cancer cases ascertained through the South Carolina Central Cancer Registry, and 429 controls identified through the Health Care Financing Administration Medicare beneficiary file (with respective response rates of 71% and 64%).
reason: The abstract analyzes incident prostate cancer overall and does not report an aggressive, high-grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Increasing lycopene consumption was associated with a reduced risk of prostate cancer among Caucasian men (p = 0.03), but not among African-American men.
estimate_classifications.reason: This lycopene estimate concerns prostate cancer overall; no aggressive endpoint is identified.
